request.query: Floor function square root bound: sqrt x < floor x for x >= 2; integer part lies between x-1 and x

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.sqrt_lt_self",
      "informal_name": "Square Root Less Than Self for Natural Numbers Greater Than One",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 < n → n.sqrt < n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $n$ greater than 1, the square root of $n$ is strictly less than $n$, i.e., $\\sqrt{n} < n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.real_sqrt_lt_nat_sqrt_succ",
      "informal_name": "Real Square Root is Less Than Natural Square Root Plus One",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {a : ℕ}, √↑a < ↑a.sqrt + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \\sqrt{a} < \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor + 1 $, where $ \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.add_one_sqrt_le_of_ne_zero",
      "informal_name": "Square Root of $n + 1$ is at Most $n$ for Non-Zero $n$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (n + 1).sqrt ≤ n",
      "informal_description": "For any non-zero natural number $n$, the square root of $n + 1$ is less than or equal to $n$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.real_sqrt_le_nat_sqrt_succ",
      "informal_name": "Real Square Root is Less Than or Equal to Integer Square Root Plus One",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {a : ℕ}, √↑a ≤ ↑a.sqrt + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \\sqrt{a} \\leq \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor + 1 $, where $ \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.sqrt_mul_sqrt_lt_succ'",
      "informal_name": "Square of Integer Square Root is Less Than n + 1",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℕ), n.sqrt ^ 2 < n + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $, the square of the integer square root of $ n $ is less than $ n + 1 $. Symbolically, $ \\lfloor \\sqrt{n} \\rfloor^2 < n + 1 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.sqrt_mul_sqrt_lt_succ",
      "informal_name": "Square of Integer Square Root is Less Than Successor",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n : ℕ), n.sqrt * n.sqrt < n + 1",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ n $, the square of the integer square root of $ n $ is strictly less than $ n + 1 $, i.e., $ (\\lfloor \\sqrt{n} \\rfloor)^2 < n + 1 $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Real.floor_real_sqrt_eq_nat_sqrt",
      "informal_name": "Floor of Real Square Root Equals Natural Square Root",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {a : ℕ}, ⌊√↑a⌋ = ↑a.sqrt",
      "informal_description": "For any natural number $ a $, the floor of the square root of $ a $ (considered as a real number) is equal to the natural number square root of $ a $, i.e., $ \\lfloor \\sqrt{a} \\rfloor = \\text{Nat.sqrt}(a) $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.minFac_lemma",
      "informal_name": "Nat.minFac_lemma: Inequality Involving Square Roots and Natural Numbers",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ (n k : ℕ), ¬n < k * k → n.sqrt - k < n.sqrt + 2 - k",
      "informal_description": "For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, if $n$ is not less than $k^2$, then $\\sqrt{n} - k < \\sqrt{n} + 2 - k$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Defs"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_name: Square Root Less Than Self for Natural Numbers Greater Than One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ greater than 1, the square root of $n$ is strictly less than $n$, i.e., $\sqrt{n} < n$.

items.informal_name: Real Square Root is Less Than Natural Square Root Plus One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \sqrt{a} < \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor + 1 $, where $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.

items.informal_name: Square Root of $n + 1$ is at Most $n$ for Non-Zero $n$
items.informal_description: For any non-zero natural number $n$, the square root of $n + 1$ is less than or equal to $n$.

items.informal_name: Real Square Root is Less Than or Equal to Integer Square Root Plus One
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the real square root of $ a $ satisfies $ \sqrt{a} \leq \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor + 1 $, where $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor $ denotes the integer square root of $ a $.

items.informal_name: Square of Integer Square Root is Less Than n + 1
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the square of the integer square root of $ n $ is less than $ n + 1 $. Symbolically, $ \lfloor \sqrt{n} \rfloor^2 < n + 1 $.

items.informal_name: Square of Integer Square Root is Less Than Successor
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, the square of the integer square root of $ n $ is strictly less than $ n + 1 $, i.e., $ (\lfloor \sqrt{n} \rfloor)^2 < n + 1 $.

items.informal_name: Floor of Real Square Root Equals Natural Square Root
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ a $, the floor of the square root of $ a $ (considered as a real number) is equal to the natural number square root of $ a $, i.e., $ \lfloor \sqrt{a} \rfloor = \text{Nat.sqrt}(a) $.
